title: The zone: full screen, and a Review Focus

options.label: Both
options.act: Review mode full-screen Space; Focus filter (badge, notifications, which projects)
options.then: Make review mode go full screen, and add a Focus filter for the badge and notifications.

why: The Review window in review mode goes full screen into its own Space (⌃⌘F), with the media taking the right half as in Flex. A three-finger swipe away is everything else; swipe back and you're on the same card.

A Focus filter (SetFocusFilterIntent) lets each Focus choose: during a deep-work Focus, hide the badge and hold the notifications; during a "Review" Focus, show only Needs you. Mail and Calendar offer the same filters.
